versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the work-productivity-skillscan-security-workflow-helper skill.
- Provides practical workflows, checklists, and implementation support for popular SkillScan-style security and productivity tasks.
- Focuses on bug fixes, setup hardening, safety improvements, and reliability enhancements for agent skills.
- Delivers reusable templates and artifacts, with built-in validation and user guidance.
- Prioritizes local hardware-friendly solutions over cloud-only or resource-heavy options.
